source_snapshot.snapshot_semantics: Exact working-tree hashes at the Wash review; rehash relevant files after later implementation edits.

N39_structural_vector.meaning: synthetic shape/capacity vector only; no native runtime acceptance claimed

verified_progress_and_current_gates.f01e_owner_stage: The implementation agent reports a dynamic F01E after-state can now create a GTC replacement candidate and pass a synthetic 36/38 NORMAL plus Q..Q+2 FreshZero test; this is not the full selected Meter path.
verified_progress_and_current_gates.first_current_36_failure: stage_meter_frontend_features_from_installed48 rejects installed48_frame.rows().len() != 48 with MeterFrameIdentity; predicate is source-hash-bound in frontend_stages.rs.
verified_progress_and_current_gates.installed_audio: installed48_render remains a 48-source output shape; production lookup asks IDs 0..47.
verified_progress_and_current_gates.component_and_reader: ActiveComponentMatrix and ReaderTarget still consume A x 48; ReaderTarget has snapshot_keys_complete: bool and [u8;48] source_flags; production sets completeness only when geometry.rows().len()==48.
verified_progress_and_current_gates.partial_active_source_ids: production_callback and SpatialControl now carry an active_source_ids vector, but current projection/state still stores a 15x48 matrix and 48x1536/48x24/48 scalar histories.
verified_progress_and_current_gates.source_flags: SourceFlags remains a fixed 48 positional array; [0,0] is active/default, not absent.
verified_progress_and_current_gates.postwindow_and_features: PostWindowFanout and CurrentFeatures still require dense 48x3072 audio and 48 feature/flag rows.

absence_contract.required: Carry one ordered CodecSourceIndex list with owner/input/callback identity through installed audio, flags, features, component matrices, ReaderTarget, post-window and SpatialControl. Preserve absent IDs as no entries, and validate identical order at each handoff.

independent_count_domains.dee_profile_count_C: Separate native count domain; no mapping to JOCForge S or target T is established by this package.
independent_count_domains.36_38_equality: For the sampled 10-bed ADM vectors S=N; this numeric equality does not prove identity with DEE's canonical M or renderer C.
